title: fix(spec): 18.0 upgrade-guide entries say 18.0 supports fresh installs only
body:
Refs #24637

Clause-②: no

The `domain:spec` row of #24637. The parent closes once this PR and its three children land (#24651, #24652, #24653 are not addressed here), so this PR does not close it.

## What changes

In 18.0, `os migrate organization-ownership` refuses plan and apply on every database (exit 1, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, nothing read or written), and 18.0 supports fresh installs only. Seven ADR-0087 semantic entries under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/` compile into the 18.0 upgrade guide, and they still prescribed `--out PLAN` then `--apply --plan-file PLAN` as if 18.0 upgraded a v17 database.

Each entry now says what 18.0 supports for a v17 database, in the words PR #24635 (`f89d29e382`) landed in the CLI and the boot refusal:

> 18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path.

Each entry keeps the plan and apply steps, now introduced as "In that 18.x release, ...".

| entry | fields changed |
|:--|:--|
| `sys-metadata-organization-column-retired`, `-audit-`, `-commit-`, `-history-` | `replacement` and `acceptanceCriteria` lead with the 18.0 sentence and qualify the ceremony as 18.x; in `reason`, "the v18 ceremony" becomes "the 18.x ceremony", and the boot-refusal clause says it refuses in 18.0 on every such database |
| `ups-permission-set-id-column-retired` | `replacement` and `acceptanceCriteria` the same way; `reason` names "the 18.x ceremony" |
| `sharing-rule-declared-mirror-retired` | `replacement` leads with the 18.0 sentence; `surface` and `acceptanceCriteria` name the ceremony as 18.x |
| `cli-organization-ownership-apply-plan-file-required` | see below |

### The `cli-organization-ownership-apply-plan-file-required` entry

The command itself is this entry's whole subject. I kept the entry and rewrote the guidance rather than deleting it:

- The upgrade guide renders each entry as `` `surface` → replacement ``, then "Why not automatic" (`reason`) and "Done when" (`acceptanceCriteria`) (`packages/spec/scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts`). Nothing checks the prose against the CLI. The entry's id and step are registered, and `.changeset/pre/15211-cli-apply-reviewed-plan.md` cites it.
- The `surface` stays as it is: the bare `--apply --backup-taken` invocation that `@objectstack/cli` 18.0.0-next.1 shipped. A script written against that prerelease is still a real reader, and in 18.0 the invocation is refused.
- The `replacement` now opens with "nothing in 18.0: 18.0 refuses this invocation, as it refuses every plan and apply of `os migrate organization-ownership` on every database". Then it gives the 18.0 sentence, then the plan-file rule, introduced as "In that 18.x release".
- `reason` adds one sentence on why 18.0 holds the ceremony back. The ceremony is knowingly incomplete, and an incomplete ceremony must never certify a v17 database that the boot would then serve. This paraphrases the docblock on `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_UPGRADE_UNAVAILABLE`.
- `acceptanceCriteria` now opens with what holds on 18.0, then keeps the 18.x plan-file criteria.

Deleting the entry would drop the 18.x plan-file rule from the guide, and it would leave a next.1 script with no entry that names its invocation.

Only text changes. Every entry keeps its `id`, its step and its fields.

## Census

```
git grep -n -E "organization-ownership (--apply|--out|--dev)|--plan-file" -- packages/spec/src ':!*.test.ts'
```

At `a58972d67b`, every hit in the seven entries sits after the 18.0 sentence or under an "In that 18.x release" / "In the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path" qualifier. The one hit not in an entry is the code comment at `system/migration.zod.ts:174`, which is out of scope by the card's rule. The cli entry's `surface` (line 10) names the refused invocation and prescribes nothing.

In a rendered single-file guide (`tsx scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts --out`, written to a scratch path), the sentence "18.0 supports fresh installs only" appears 12 times: 7 replacements and 5 acceptance criteria. `sharing-rule-declared-mirror-retired`'s acceptance criteria say "18.0 upgrades no v17 database" instead.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date", with no tracked file changed. No baseline pins this text.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 83 commands, and all of them were run:
  - 80 exit 0, including `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:empty-changeset` and `check:changeset-no-major`.
  - 3 exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, so NOT MEASURED here: `check:doc-formula-expressions` (`@objectstack/formula` not built), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (workspace `dist/` absent) and `check:lean-entry-closure` (`@objectstack/objectql` not built). None reads these entries. They are declared to CI.
- No open PR touches `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`. I checked all 14 open PRs' file lists over REST.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope by the card's rule: `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` history, and the code comment at `packages/spec/src/system/migration.zod.ts:174`.
- The boot guard, the plugin-security report and the docs rows are #24651, #24652 and #24653.
